Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting the construction or operation of a light rail or other rail system on the Interstate 90 floating bridge.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting the construction or operation of alight rail or other rail system on the Interstate 90 floating bridge;and adding a new section to chapter 47.04 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.04 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A light rail system or any other rail fixed guideway system may notbe constructed or operated on the Interstate 90 floating bridge.
